name: contextrail-continue
description: Optional companion to ContextRail: after it saves a handoff, clears the session and continues from the handoff by itself.

delay_seconds.title: Delay before clearing (seconds)
delay_seconds.description: How long to wait after the handoff is saved. Start typing in that time to keep the session.

max_in_a_row.title: Automatic continues in a row
max_in_a_row.description: How many times to clear and continue without a prompt from you in between.

after_manual.title: Continue after /contextrail:handoff too
after_manual.description: Also clear and continue after a handoff you asked for, not only after ContextRail's own request.
